name: Unbounded Conversion (Ki)
body:
You can reweave the strands of magical energy with surpassing swiftness.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Wis 13, Cha 13, ki pool class feature or Ki Meditation ability to spontaneously cast spells (including limited spontaneous casting of a single spell or category of spells).

Benefit(s): This feat enables you to spontaneously cast spells in conjunction with metamagic feats without increasing the spell’s casting time as long as you have a number of points in your ki pool that is greater than the level of any such spell you cast (including the level adjustment for all metamagic feats you apply to it). If the total adjusted level of the spell equals or exceeds the number of points in your ki pool, you can still spend 1 point from your ki pool to cast the spell with its normal casting time.
